rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for observing specimens with a microscope.

example.english: We used microscopy to see whether there were bacteria in this drop of water.
example.traditional: 我哋用顯微鏡觀察睇下呢滴水入面有冇細菌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 hin2 mei4 geng3 gun1 caat3 tai2 haa5 ne1 dik6 seoi2 jap6 min6 jau5 mou5 sai3 kwan2

rows.note: Use this formal technical term for the study, design, and manufacture of microscopes.

example.english: Microscopy is a specialized field concerned with the design and manufacture of microscopes.
example.traditional: 顯微鏡學係研究顯微鏡設計同製造嘅專門學問。
example.jyutping: hin2 mei4 geng3 hok6 hai6 jin4 gau3 hin2 mei4 geng3 cit3 gai3 tung4 zai3 zou6 ge3 zyun1 mun4 hok6 man6
